SELECT ((latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.capacity) - latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.free)) / latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.capacity)) * 100 AS 'Used %' FROM Metric WHERE  host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET oracledb.asm.disk_group.name
SELECT latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.free/1073741824) FROM Metric WHERE host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET oracledb.asm.disk_group.name
SELECT latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.usable_free/1073741824) FROM Metric WHERE host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET oracledb.asm.disk_group.name
SELECT latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.offline_disks) FROM Metric WHERE host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET oracledb.asm.disk_group.name
SELECT latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.capacity) - latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.free) FROM Metric WHERE host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET oracledb.asm.disk_group.name TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT ((latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.capacity) - latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.free)) / latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.capacity)) * 100 AS 'Used %' FROM Metric WHERE host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET oracledb.asm.disk_group.name
SELECT latest(oracledb.asm.disk.errors) FROM Metric WHERE host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET  disk.io.direction TIMESERIES AUTO SINCE 3 days ago UNTIL now
SELECT sum(oracledb.asm.disk.errors) FROM Metric WHERE host.name IN ({{host_name}}) AND disk.io.direction = 'read' FACET oracledb.asm.disk.name
SELECT sum(oracledb.asm.disk.errors) FROM Metric WHERE host.name IN ({{host_name}}) AND disk.io.direction = 'write' FACET oracledb.asm.disk.name

SELECT latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.capacity) AS 'Capacity', latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.free) AS 'Free', latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.usable_free) AS 'Usable Free', latest(oracledb.asm.disk_group.offline_disks) AS 'Offline Disks' FROM Metric WHERE host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET oracledb.asm.disk_group.name

FROM DbServerTopQuery SELECT db.query.text, oracledb.sql_id, oracledb.elapsed_time, oracledb.cpu_time, oracledb.executions, oracledb.buffer_gets WHERE db.system.name = 'oracle' AND host.name IN ({{host_name}}) ORDER BY oracledb.elapsed_time DESC LIMIT 20
FROM DbServerTopQuery SELECT average(oracledb.cpu_time) WHERE db.system.name = 'oracle' AND host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET db.query.text, oracledb.sql_id LIMIT 10
FROM DbServerTopQuery SELECT rate(sum(oracledb.executions), 1 SECOND) WHERE db.system.name = 'oracle' AND host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET host.name TIMESERIES

FROM DbServerTopProcedure SELECT oracledb.procedure_name, oracledb.elapsed_time, oracledb.cpu_time, oracledb.procedure_execution_count, oracledb.buffer_gets WHERE db.system.name = 'oracle' AND host.name IN ({{host_name}}) ORDER BY oracledb.elapsed_time DESC LIMIT 20
FROM DbServerTopProcedure SELECT sum(oracledb.procedure_execution_count) WHERE db.system.name = 'oracle' AND host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET oracledb.procedure_name LIMIT 10
FROM DbServerQuerySample SELECT count(*) WHERE db.system.name = 'oracle' AND host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET host.name TIMESERIES
FROM DbServerQuerySample SELECT count(*) WHERE db.system.name = 'oracle' AND host.name IN ({{host_name}}) FACET oracledb.wait_class LIMIT 10

FROM DbServerQuerySample SELECT oracledb.sid, oracledb.blocking.blocker.sid, oracledb.blocking.wait_duration, oracledb.blocking.lock.type, db.query.text WHERE db.system.name = 'oracle' AND host.name IN ({{host_name}}) AND oracledb.blocking.blocker.sid IS NOT NULL AND oracledb.blocking.blocker.sid != '' LIMIT 20
